title: Tennis: Eala, Sonmez booted out of Wuhan doubles first round after loss to wildcard pair
summary: Star duo Alex Eala and Zeynep Sonmez made a quick exit in the Wuhan Open doubles, falling to wildcard pair Anhelina Kalinina and Dayana Yastremska, 2-6, 3-6, on Tuesday.
